summary: Squirrel ThrottleScalerMultiplier 1.375->1.65 raised to 1.5->1.8 (50% lever). #2200's 37.5% notch had been fitted to judge races that flew a Scarab in the Squirrel's seat (bug fixed in #2208). Re-judged: five-hull imbalance card 1.06, L5 1.075 (20 fresh + shipped). Skim Race rungs stay inside their bars, but I2 slows from ~148 s to ~207 s mean (one 299 s on a 300 s bar). A Skim Race AI retrain at the new throttle is the follow-up.
